body:
I just underwent surgery 2 days ago and thought this would be worth sharing with the world.
I had a good discussion with my anesthesiologist about drugs because clearly we both find them fascinating. She told me that Ketamine is a phenomenal pain management drug.
Based on this, I decided to try out deschloroketamine because I had some on me. I snorted roughly 50mg (I have a noteworthy disso tolerance atm) and did not notice any strong dissociation, however the pain mitigation was actually more noticeable than with the percocets I was prescribed (to which I have no real tolerance because I don't dabble in opiates).
This discovery seemed extremely important to me as DCK is available in the Domestic US and the pain mitigating effects right now are truly phenomenal. My liver is thanking me right this second. Hopefully someone else's liver out there can thank them one day as well.
